summary: Second appeal jurisdiction under CPC s.100 requiring substantial question of law; Kerala Land Conservancy Act s.20 bar analysis; adverse possession claim over 50 years versus statutory 30-year requirement; quasi-judicial authority impleadment procedure; testimony credibility assessment on tree age/improvements; High Court's reappreciation of evidence illegitimate without framing substantial questions of law; Trial Court findings reinstated.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; decree of Trial Court restored.
